subject: Re: Charged twice on my card
body:
Hi Julien,

I am sorry to hear that. Anything to do with a card charge needs a person to look into properly, so our Guest Relations team will personally review this and follow up with you today.
ai_suggested_reply:
Hi Julien,

I am sorry about that. I have checked booking RES-7002 and can see two charges on the same date - we will refund the duplicate charge today and send you a confirmation once it clears.

The Hotel Aurora team
